title: Ashfall County
brief: Lead a small community of survivors in a quarantined 4 km x 4 km county (2-6 km options): pick where you set down on a drop map, scavenge rucksacks of food, meds, ammo, materials and fuel for your home base, build facilities, recruit named survivors, and fight or flee a tiered bestiary (walkers to juggernauts) while AI rival crews and raiders loot the same towns and Guard airdrops and artillery red zones reshape each day. Destroy every plague heart to cleanse the county.

world.generator: Game/Assets/Ashfall/Core/WorldGen.cs + GenLandmarks.cs (generator version 2, deterministic per seed)
world.contents: Ash River and highway bridge, county highway, Route 9 and county roads, Cedar Fork plus towns scaled to map size, farms, forests and ponds. Landmarks: Fort Ashby (military base), Ashfall Regional Airfield, County Hospital, KAFC radio station, Reed's Garage, Red Talon Yard (raider compound), warehouses, churches, schools, motels, campgrounds and named farmsteads. 8-12 named landing zones.
rules: Zombie spawns are land-only: never water, walls or furniture, never within 28 m of the start or inside the home site; freaks never within 60 m of the start.
Population density follows zones: commercial > town > military > suburb > farm > wild > forest; water has none.
Plague hearts sit inside town and landmark buildings at least 400 m from the start; rival crews land at least 300 m from the base.
Containers roll loot lazily from the seed; rucksacks and loot tiers follow building kind and landmark.
Saves regenerate the county from its seed and store only changed state (save version 3, tagged sections).
world.legacyNote: The previous three-chapter Frontier stages are retired from the build; their sources are kept in Legacy/.

enemies.behaviour: Wander, investigate noise, chase, attack, thump doors, climb windows, crowd.
A scream summons nearby zombies; a gas cloud on death; frontal riot armour.
Fast pouncing hunter, more common at night.
Charges, grabs and tears; shove-immune; a group or explosive fight.
Spawns plague zombies and screams when hit; destroying all of them wins the legacy.
Raiders and hunters attack on sight; opportunists rob the weak; wary groups fight back.

story.premise: Ashfall County has been sealed by the Guard. Your group sets down after a failed evacuation and must hold together through Ada Pike's emergency band, enclave missions, Guard airdrops and artillery, and the plague hearts that keep the dead coming.
story.goal: Destroy every plague heart (outcome "legacy"). The game ends only when every community member is dead (outcome "dead").
events: Radio broadcasts and daily community reports
Missions: rescue, supply, clear infestation, kill freak, hunt, defend
Guard airdrops with a fly-over and red smoke

studioIntro.creator: ProgrammingSecurely
studioIntro.presentation: Game title and creator credits over the actual scene when available; no fabricated gameplay video.

systems.coreLoop: Leave base, scavenge rucksacks and gear, handle threats, return and deposit, spend materials and influence on facilities, outposts and recruits, take missions, destroy plague hearts.
systems.community: Members with health (capped by injury), stamina, fatigue, blood plague, traits and skills; one controlled, one companion (Follow/Hold/Attack), residents and a watchtower garrison. Daily upkeep at 06:00 (Food, Meds, Fuel), morale and influence.
systems.base: A home site claimed near the landing zone; facility slots by size: Storage, Beds, Infirmary, Workshop, Watchtower, Garden, Kitchen and Radio Room (levels 1-3, built over in-game hours from Materials). Outposts are claimed from cleared buildings.
systems.resources: Shared stock of Food, Meds, Ammo, Materials and Fuel, delivered in heavy rucksacks (carried or in a car trunk). Weighted loot tables by room and building, with tiers Common, Uncommon, Rare and Military.
systems.humans: Every human is a Survivor; AI brains submit the same input and commands as a player (loot, fight, flee, follow, guard, hunt, airdrop). Factions with standing and dispositions (Friendly, Wary, Opportunist, Hunter). Simulated abstractly beyond about 170 m. Talk, trade and recruit.
systems.bestiary: Walker, crawler, screamer, bloater, armored, feral, juggernaut, plague zombies and plague hearts; hordes; gas and fire hazards. Threat tiers 1-5 on nameplates.
systems.worldEvents: Airdrops (announcement, plane, parachute, red smoke, tier 2-3 loot) and artillery red zones (warning, shelling, clear), each optional.
systems.combat: Melee arcs and knockdowns, shove, firearms with tracers, armour vests and helmets, headshots, and throwables (grenade, molotov, pipe bomb).
systems.noise: Footsteps, combat, glass, gunshots, screams, explosions and engines draw zombies, muffled by walls.
systems.vehicles: About 40% of intact cars run; keys or hotwiring; fuel; collisions; running down zombies; trunks carry rucksacks to base.
systems.interaction: E performs the focused action; Q opens every nearby action. All requests are host commands validated for reach, line of sight, stock, influence, standing and ownership.
systems.authority: Host-authoritative simulation (Simulation.Submit/SetInput). LAN is not implemented for the rebuilt game.
systems.saves: Atomic, versioned (3), gzip-compressed seed + delta saves with tagged sections (vehicles, survival, bestiary, humans, community, events, player, roles); autosave every 5 minutes and on quit. Older saves are refused with an explanation and left untouched.
systems.retired: Personal hunger, thirst, boredom, wetness and smoking; fishing; skill books; utility shut-off; water containers; cooking; per-plot farming (replaced by the base Garden).

playtime.designBasis: Design target: destroying 8-14 plague hearts on a 4 km county over several in-game weeks. Not measured.
playtime.freePlay: Endless community survival; options for map size, population, zombie speed, freaks, humans, airdrops, red zones, day length and founding members.
playtime.acceptance: Measure normal play sessions; automated probes and staged captures do not establish playtime.

assets.policy: Use compatible owned art for characters, props, weapons, vehicles, animations, audio and HUD sprites. Keep gameplay logic, controls, collision and progression owned by the game; procedural stand-ins are used when a private pack is not restored.
assets.provenance: Hash-pin selected original files, licence source and native references. Owned/downloaded/candidate is not proof of runtime integration.
assets.runtimeBindings: Generated at build time: Game/Assets/Resources/AshfallArt.json (role -> prepared prefab) by Game/Assets/Editor/PrepareAshfallArt.cs
assets.licenceNotes: Leartes glass-break WAVs: confirm the licence allows non-Unreal use before shipping.

requiredChecks: Native new game on each county size: drop map, landing zones, home site, spawn clearance and water exclusion
Keyboard/mouse and physical controller: movement, aiming, combat, throwing, interaction and every menu
Community: members, switching, companion orders, rucksack deposits, facilities, outposts, recruiting, missions, morale and daily upkeep
Bestiary: each freak's behaviour, plague infection and cure, plague hearts, hordes and hazards
AI humans: enclaves, crews and raiders loot, fight and react by disposition; talk and trade; distance LOD transitions
World events: airdrops and red zones in normal play
Legacy and community-lost outcomes, save/reload and autosave
Purchased characters/items: import, runtime reference, animation and interaction
Measured playtime, performance in towns on 4 and 6 km counties, platform builds, distribution signing and Steam acceptance
acceptance.latestValidation: Docs/ValidationReports; distinguish current native evidence from historical (Frontier-era) reports
